title: pilosella pilosellina subsp. pseudoradians
intro: Pilosella pilosellina subsp. pseudoradians, commonly known as a species of flowering plant in the sunflower family, is a rare subspecies with limited information available. However, based on its relationship with other Pilosella species, it is likely to have similar therapeutic properties. As with other members of the genus, Pilosella pilosellina subsp. pseudoradians may have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, due to its ability to inhibit the growth of certain microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of Pilosella pilosellina subsp. pseudoradians are likely to include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions.
